review:
Cursed Crypt is a 5x4 ways slot set in an Egyptian tomb, with one central mechanic: when a Curse symbol lands it spreads upward to the top of its reel, and each cursed position is replaced with a random symbol. It works like a reel-filling modifier, re-rolling part of the grid to give you a second chance at a connection.

The Wrath of Sobek bonus gives ten free spins with more Curse symbols, and four scatters unlock the Tomb of Tutankhamun round, where you can also win extra spins. It's a simpler game than most recent Hacksaw releases, and the 10,000x cap is reachable in every mode.
